svg.text: Ep. 9: The Shadow on the Stones: the three clues (second showing)
Clue 1 · only when the sun is low
noon: short stubby shadows, no hound
sunset: long shadows, the hound appears

svg.text: Clue 2: when Tavita lifts the telescope, the shadow's snout lifts too

svg.text: Clue 3: Kurstin's cap flaps are the hound's pointed ears
